## Description

Brief description of the change. Reference related issues with
`Closes #123` where applicable.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing
      functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation change
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt` clean, `go vet ./...` passes; frontend: `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Tests added or updated where the logic is testable without OS/Wails
      (`xvfb-run -a go test ./...`; Windows-only `internal/` packages:
      `GOOS=windows go vet ./internal/...`)
- [ ] OS-specific behavior added via `//go:build` files plus no-op stubs
      (not `runtime.GOOS` checks), and checked on the platforms I could
- [ ] `frontend/wailsjs/` regenerated by `wails dev`/`wails build`, not hand-edited
- [ ] No real patient data, credentials, tokens, window titles or dictated
      text in code, tests, screenshots, or logs
- [ ] AGPL/SPDX license header added to new source files
      (`python3 scripts/add_spdx_headers.py --dry-run`, `reuse lint`)
- [ ] Dependencies added or changed? `python3 scripts/check_licenses.py --write-notices`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] `docs/data-mapping.md` / `SECURITY.md` updated if data handling, network
      traffic, logging, clipboard or local storage changed
- [ ] `.agents/AGENTS.md` updated if dev commands, architecture, or gotchas changed
- [ ] "Kein Medizinprodukt" disclaimer and the explicit accept-and-insert step
      preserved (only relevant if the login or insert flow was touched)
